cases.description: Without a generator meta tag the group does not hold. There is deliberately no positive case: the rule matches any page that declares a generator (a Hugo site included), so it cannot be called reliable as 'Metatag CMS'; it stays unknown.
Both members are needed: the content type must be html.
The group requires status 200: an Apache error page is not detected by this group.
The rule needs a version after the slash; a bare 'nginx' is not matched by this group.
The raw response (headers and body) holds the Wix header.
A page that only mentions wix.
The groups for 403 and 404 are separate; a 500 matches none.
